triggers.prompt: Read the attached synastry_Person-A_Person-B.txt and interpret what it says about our relationship. I want the result saved as a report I can keep.
triggers.expected: Fires on an existing two-person synastry data file and writes the fixed Markdown reading without recalculating the chart.

triggers.prompt: 请解读刚才生成的 synastry_甲_乙.txt，爱情、友情、事业合作和金钱都要分析，结果保存成 Markdown。
triggers.expected: Fires on the Chinese interpretation request, reads the existing measurements, and writes the complete Chinese Markdown template.

triggers.prompt: The synastry calculator has successfully written ./charts/synastry_A_B.txt. Continue the configured workflow with that exact file.
triggers.expected: Fires as the automatic post-calculation hand-off and does not ask the user to confirm the analysis.

triggers.prompt: Below are two natal blocks, a cross-chart aspect table with orbs, and both directions of house overlays from an existing synastry calculation. Analyze these measurements using the standard relationship-reading format.
triggers.expected: Fires when complete equivalent synastry data is pasted instead of attached as a file.

non_triggers.prompt: Run a synastry for A, born 1990-03-14 at 07:42 in Shanghai, and B, born 1988-11-02 at 21:05 in New York.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Raw birth details must be calculated by synastry first.

non_triggers.prompt: Interpret my natal chart from this list of planetary placements and houses.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. A single natal chart is not a two-person synastry reading.

non_triggers.prompt: Use my transits to forecast whether I will meet a partner next month.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Transits and forecasts are outside this skill.

non_triggers.prompt: Recompute our synastry with whole-sign houses and a 1.5 degree minor orb.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Changing houses or orbs requires a new calculation.

behaviors.prompt: Interpret the complete attached synastry_A_B.txt and save the reading beside it.
expectations: Writes synastry_reading_A_B.md beside the source file and reports both paths.
Uses the fixed section order: basis and limitations, relationship overview, love, friendship, business partnership, money, overall synthesis, and evidence index.
Includes every required subsection under love, friendship, business partnership, and money.
Supports each substantive interpretation with an exact aspect including both bodies, aspect type, and orb, or with a directional house overlay naming both people.
Does not recompute placements, alter the source orbs, invent missing evidence, predict events, or assign a compatibility score.

behaviors.prompt: Analyze this synastry excerpt. It has both natal charts and some aspects, but the house-overlay section is missing.
expectations: Names both missing overlay directions as required source sections.
Does not write a partial Markdown reading.
Asks for the complete data file or a fresh calculation rather than estimating the overlays.

behaviors.prompt: Read this complete synastry file. Its points section says Chiron, Ceres, Pallas, Juno, and Vesta were not resolved because the ephemeris data file was missing.
expectations: Writes the reading because the required natal, aspect, and overlay sections are complete.
Repeats the unresolved-body limitation in the report.
Does not interpret or imply contacts involving any unresolved body.

behaviors.prompt: 用这份完整的中文合盘数据生成固定模板的解读报告。
expectations: Uses the headings 分析基础与限制、关系总览、爱情、友情、事业合作、金钱、综合结论、证据索引 in that order.
Preserves every cited orb exactly as recorded in the source.
